# @arki/db

> Drizzle ORM helpers for ARKI: Postgres and PGlite runtimes, branded ids, feature-owned schema, repositories for Dot features, and serializable transactional procedures for oRPC. It is not a query builder and not a migration tool.

Only SQLSTATE `40001` and `40P01` are retried. Effects inside a transaction run once per attempt.

## Import paths

<!-- llms:start -->
- `@arki/db`: Open a node-postgres pool and wrap it in Drizzle: `initDb`. `DB_COMPOSITION_ERROR_CODES`, `DbCompositionError`, `composeSchema`, `createDb`, `createUnitOfWork`, `getDbConnectionOptions`, `getDbConnectionParams`, `initDb`, `initDbWithOptions`; types `ComposedSchema`, `TransactionalDb`, `UnitOfWork`; and 1 more.
- one path each: `@arki/db/env`, `@arki/db/init`, `@arki/db/factory`, `@arki/db/builder`, `@arki/db/client`, `@arki/db/runtime-local`, `@arki/db/id`, `@arki/db/id-factory`, `@arki/db/orm`, `@arki/db/pg`, `@arki/db/libsql`, `@arki/db/libsql/dot`, `@arki/db/sqlite`, `@arki/db/columns`, `@arki/db/dialect`, `@arki/db/temporal`, `@arki/db/bun`, `@arki/db/dot`, `@arki/db/migrate`, `@arki/db/pagination`, `@arki/db/transaction`, `@arki/db/errors`, `@arki/db/contract`, `@arki/db/orpc`, `@arki/db/eslint`.
<!-- llms:end -->

## Rules that bite

- `transact` is the last `.use()` of the procedure. Anything after it reruns on every retry (`ARKI_DB_TX_E004`).
- Pass `transactionalProcedureConfig` to `implement`, or output is validated after the commit.
- No `fetch`, queue writes or `.effect()` inside transactional code. They run once per attempt and do not roll back.
- A lost connection around `COMMIT` is never retried. Recover with an idempotency key and a journal receipt.
- PGlite never conflicts (one connection). Prove retry behaviour on real PostgreSQL.
- In a Dot feature, rename the pool-bound repos source to `repositories`. The bound set is `repos`.
